issues.name: No custom font-size values
issues.msg: Custom font-size '0.625rem' detected. Use Carbon type tokens instead.
issues.fix: Use @include type.type-style('body-01') (or matching style) with @use '@carbon/react/scss/type' as type; — type tokens are Sass maps and cannot be used as scalar values

issues.name: No custom line-height values
issues.msg: Custom line-height '1rem' detected. Consider using Carbon line-height tokens.
issues.fix: Line-height is part of Carbon type-style maps. Use @include type.type-style('body-01') with @use '@carbon/react/scss/type' as type; — $line-height-* variables do not exist
